simple.meaning: אֲלֻמָּה (ʼălummâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something bound ; a sheaf.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲלֻמָּה (H485) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 37:7, with occurrences in Genesis, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲלֻמָּה (H485) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲלֻמָּה (H485) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲלֻמָּה (ʼălummâh) / H485 is traced through Genesis 37:7, Psalms 126:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H485. alummah [ אֲלֻמָּה ] noun feminine sheaf , in Joseph's dream Gen 37:7 (4 t. in verse) (E) followed by suffix אֲלֻמָּתִי , plural אֲלֻמֹּתֵיכֶם אֲלֻמִּים, ; also Psa 126:6 אֲלֻמֹּתָיו (in figurative of ret. from captivity).
